Here are quick wins to stretch your phone’s battery:

- Screen first: lower brightness, use auto-brightness, shorten auto‑lock, enable dark mode (especially on OLED).
- Trim background drain: disable Background App Refresh (or restrict to essentials), turn off unnecessary widgets and live wallpapers.
- Tame radios: turn off 5G when not needed, disable Wi‑Fi/Bluetooth/Location when idle; set Location to “While Using.”
- Notifications: mute non‑essential alerts to cut wake‑ups.
- Power modes: enable Low Power/Power Saving Mode early, not just at 10%.
- Streaming/data: download playlists/podcasts on Wi‑Fi; reduce video resolution on mobile data.
- Charging/health: avoid heat, don’t run 0–100% daily; aim for ~20–80% with Optimized Charging on; use certified chargers.
- Maintenance: update OS/apps, reboot weekly; check Battery usage to spot hog apps and replace them if needed.

Since you already have a portable power bank and a wireless pad, keep them handy for top‑ups—no need to buy extra accessories.
